specs.Other Special Features of the Product: 2-way 22.5w (Max) fast charging, 22.5W smooth non-skid wireless charging surface, Aluminum alloy casing

features: Charges your devices simultaneously with two USB A output ports.
Supports 2-way 22.5w (Max) fast charging (Quick Charge 3.0 & Power Delivery charging).
The power bank has intelligent input and output controls and LED indicators for a seamless experience.
The device offers a world-class built-in 12-layer smart IC protection against short circuits, overcharging, over-discharging, and more!
The sleek and durable Aluminum alloy casing offers protection with style.
The Pass-Through Simultaneous Charge-Discharge feature allows you to charge your power bud while it charges your devices.
